props.name: value
props.description: Current value. Clamped to `[min, max]`.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower bound (default 0).

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound (default 100).

props.name: low
props.description: Upper edge of the low region. Values below it are "low".

props.name: high
props.description: Lower edge of the high region. Values above it are "high".

props.name: optimum
props.description: The ideal value; decides which region reads as good.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label ("Disk"). Also the meter's accessible name.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Human-readable value, shown next to the label and used as `aria-valuetext` ("42 GB of 64 GB"). Defaults to a percentage.

props.name: tone
props.description: Force a tone instead of deriving it from the thresholds.

props.name: segments
props.description: Number of blocks the range is divided into (default 20).

props.name: size
props.description: Block height: sm 8px, md 12px (default).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the dialog: set it true to open, and false when `onOpenChange(false)` fires. Omit it (and use `defaultOpen`) for a dialog that manages its own state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not passed (default false). The dialog then closes itself on Escape, the scrim or the close button.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the user asks to close (close button, Escape, or a scrim click). Set `open` to false here when the dialog is controlled.

props.name: isOpen
props.deprecated: Use `open`. Still honoured when `open` is not passed.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading in the fixed header; also the dialog's accessible name, so make it say what the dialog is for.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content. It scrolls inside the panel when it is taller than the viewport allows; header and footer stay fixed.

props.name: footerContent
props.description: Optional fixed footer for CTAs. Render DS Buttons here (e.g. a secondary "Cancel" + primary confirm); actions align to the right on a subtle band.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width: `sm` (360px) for a short confirmation or notice, `md` (640px) for a compare card or a short form, `lg` (740px, the default when neither `size` nor `width` is passed) for a full task, `full` for the whole viewport width. The panel never grows past the viewport.

props.name: width
props.deprecated: Use `size`. Still honoured when `size` is not passed: numbers are px, strings pass through.

props.name: docked
props.description: Dock instead of covering: at or above the `--breakpoint-docked` token (960px) the panel pins bottom-center with no scrim and no scroll lock (a non-modal dialog), keeping the page behind visible and interactive. Below it this is ignored and the standard centered modal renders, so the responsive fallback lives here, not in the consumer.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based (controlled). Pair with `onPageChange`.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages. Renders nothing when 0.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Starting page when uncontrolled (default 1).

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Fires with the requested 1-based page when the user picks a page or steps prev/next.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page (default 1).

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and end (default 1).

props.name: size
props.description: Plate height from the Button scale: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. Hit areas stay 44px or more.

props.name: showPrevNext
props.description: Show the previous/next arrow buttons (default true).

props.name: getPageLabel
props.description: Accessible name of each page button (default "Page 3").

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous button (default "Previous page").

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next button (default "Next page").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark (default "Pagination").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the `<nav>`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`; omit for uncontrolled use.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled (default false).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the popover asks to open or close (trigger, Escape, outside click, blur).

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that toggles the popover, usually a `Button`. It receives `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-haspopup`, and a click handler that toggles the panel (your own `onClick` still runs first).

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Position against an element you render yourself instead of `trigger` (e.g. an input). Clicks inside the anchor never count as outside clicks. You own opening and ARIA wiring in that case.

props.name: children
props.description: Panel content.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor (default "bottom"). Flips when there is no room.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the anchor edge (default "start").

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap between anchor and panel, in px (default 8, one plate step multiple).

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Close when the user presses outside the trigger and panel (default true).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Close on Escape (default true).

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus into the panel on open: the first focusable element, else the panel itself (default true). Set false for panels that must leave focus on the anchor, like a combobox listbox.

props.name: returnFocus
props.description: Send focus back to the trigger when closed via Escape or the trigger (default true).

props.name: matchAnchorWidth
props.description: Make the panel at least as wide as the anchor (default false).

props.name: id
props.description: Id for the panel; generated when omitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer ring layer (width, max-width).

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the inner fill (padding, layout). Defaults to `p-4`.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render the panel into `document.body` (default false). Turn this on inside plate-clipped containers (Card, Modal): clip-path clips even fixed-position descendants. Inline rendering keeps DOM order, so Tab flows from the trigger into the panel; a portaled panel relies on `autoFocus` instead.

props.name: triggerWrapperClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the span that wraps `trigger`.

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role of the panel: "dialog" (the default, a non-modal dialog), any other ARIA role, or `null`. A dialog needs a name, and the type requires one: pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Pass `null` when the content carries its own role (a listbox, a menu).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the panel. Required for `role="dialog"` unless `aria-labelledby` is set.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible heading inside the panel that names it. Required for `role="dialog"` unless `aria-label` is set.

props.name: value
props.description: Current progress, 0 to `max`. Omit (or pass `null`) for an indeterminate bar.

props.name: max
props.description: Value that means complete (default 100).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Uploading report.pdf". Shown above the bar unless `showLabel` is false.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label visually (default true). When false it is still announced.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage next to the label for determinate bars (default true).

props.name: size
props.description: Track thickness: sm, md (default), lg.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fill colour by meaning: primary (the default accent), or a semantic role: neutral, info, success, warning, error.

props.name: variant
props.description: Fill colour under its old name. When both are set, `tone` wins.

props.name: segments
props.description: Number of blocks across the track (default 20, so each block is 5%).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root (width).

props.name: size
props.description: Box size: sm 16px, md 20px (default), lg 24px. The tap target is 44×44px at every size.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label next to the box; clicking it selects the radio. Without one, pass `aria-label`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error styling without a message. Prefer `errorMessage` so users learn what to fix. Styling only: announce the invalid state with `aria-invalid` on the group (`<fieldset role="radiogroup">`), since ARIA does not support it on a radio.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Secondary line under the label (explains what picking this option means).

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Validation message under the label, read through `aria-describedby`. Sets the error styling and replaces `helperText`. Put `aria-invalid` on the group, not here.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with this radio's checked state after a change (alternative to `onChange`). A radio only fires when it becomes selected, so the value is `true`; losing selection to a sibling fires nothing, as with a native radio.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional visible label; associates with the custom trigger (the combobox) via `htmlFor` / `id`.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. Legacy names are deprecated aliases.

props.name: error
props.description: Error styling without a message. Prefer `errorMessage` so users learn what to fix.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Hint shown under the trigger. Linked via `aria-describedby`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Validation message shown under the trigger. Sets the error state and `aria-invalid`, and replaces `helperText` while present.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark, e.g. "Primary". Required when the page has more than one `<nav>`.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Icon-only rail: labels become accessible names plus tooltips.

props.name: children
props.description: SideNavSection and/or SideNavItem children.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the `<nav>` (width, height, borders).

props.name: children
props.description: SideNavItem rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the section wrapper.

props.name: heading
props.description: Optional section heading. Screen-reader only when the rail is collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested SideNavItem rows. Turns this row into a collapsible group button with `aria-expanded`; `href` / `onClick` are then ignored.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the row element.

props.name: label
props.description: Row text. Also the accessible name and tooltip in collapsed mode.

props.name: icon
props.description: 1-bit icon shown before the label (strongly recommended; required for a useful collapsed rail).

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current route: holds the hover fill and sets `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination; renders an `<a>`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. Without `href`, the row renders as a `<button>`.

props.name: as
props.description: Custom link component (e.g. a router `<Link>`); its props go in `asProps`.

props.name: asProps
props.description: Props for the `as` component (`to`, `state`, ...), spread onto it as-is. They are spread untyped: TypeScript does not check them against the `as` component's own props, so a misspelt `to` is not caught at compile time.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing content at the row end (a count Badge, a Kbd hint). Hidden when collapsed.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Group open state (controlled).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial group open state. Defaults to true when a descendant is `active`.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires when a group row toggles.

props.name: variant
props.description: Placeholder shape: text lines (default), a rect block, or an avatar square.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines for `variant="text"` (default 1). The last of several is shorter.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar square size: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px (control heights). Only the `avatar` variant reads it: `text` and `rect` ignore it, so size those with `lines` and `className`. Legacy small/medium/large are deprecated aliases.

props.name: animated
props.description: Whether the stepped pulse runs. Defaults to `true`; pass `false` to hold the placeholder still (e.g. many skeletons on one screen). Reduced motion always stops the pulse, whatever this says.

props.name: className
props.description: Sizing classes. Rects need a height (e.g. `h-32 w-full`); text lines take the container width.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label tied to the input with htmlFor/id; one of `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required. Put the current value in it when users need to see the number.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when the slider has no visible label of its own (a zoom slider in a toolbar).

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of visible text elsewhere that names the slider, such as a column heading.

props.name: size
props.description: Box size: sm 12px (inline, 32px controls), md 16px (default), lg 24px (48px controls, empty states).

props.name: label
props.description: What is loading, read by screen readers and never shown (default "Loading"). Be specific when several things load at once: "Loading invoices".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper, e.g. a text color (`text-[var(--text-secondary)]`).

props.name: left
props.description: Left zone segments (mode, branch, file).

props.name: center
props.description: Center zone segments (message, progress).

props.name: right
props.description: Right zone segments (position, encoding, clock).

props.name: live
props.description: Announce changes politely (`role="status"`). Off by default to avoid chatter.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the bar (default "Status").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the segment.

props.name: icon
props.description: 1-bit icon before the text. Use one with any non-neutral tone.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic tone (default "neutral").

props.name: children
props.description: Segment text. Keep it to a few words.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is on, for a controlled switch: keep it in state and update it from `onCheckedChange`. Omit it (and use `defaultChecked`) to let the switch keep its own state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled switch starts on. Ignored when `checked` is set. Default: false.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the next value when the user clicks the track or label, or presses Space or Enter. A controlled switch cannot change without it.

props.name: size
props.description: Track size. The tap target is at least 44px tall at every size.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name; one of `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required. Clicking it toggles the switch. Use `hideLabel` to keep it aria-only.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no `label` (a theme toggle whose state is shown by an icon). Wins over `label` when both are set.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of visible text elsewhere that names the switch, such as a settings row heading. Wins over `label` and `aria-label`.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Keep `label` as the accessible name only (no visible text). Use in compositions where the row already carries a visible heading, such as a settings row, so the name isn't duplicated next to the track.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the switch. Prefer explaining nearby why a setting is unavailable.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon drawn inside the knob, for a switch whose two states have a picture (a moon and sun for the theme toggle).

props.name: striped
props.description: Zebra striping for body rows (even rows use `surface-subtle`).

props.name: bordered
props.description: Full outer border around the table.

props.name: density
props.description: Row padding rhythm (default `compact`); cells read it via context.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows instead of the children while the data loads. Sets `aria-busy` on the parent `Table`; keep it on until the real rows render.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: How many Skeleton rows `loading` shows (default 3). Match the page size you expect so the table does not jump when the rows arrive.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: What to show when the body has no rows: a sentence, or an `EmptyState size="sm"`. Rendered in one cell spanning every column. Ignored while `loading`.

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Columns the loading and empty rows span. Leave it unset to use the `TableHeader` column count; set it when the table has no header row.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected panel id (controlled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when the active tab changes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial panel when uncontrolled; use `undefined` to auto-select the first tab.

props.name: children
props.description: One `TabsList` followed by a `TabsContent` for each trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the wrapper (width, spacing between the strip and panels).

props.name: children
props.description: The `TabsTrigger` buttons, in the order the arrow keys move through them.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the tab strip (alignment, overflow).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab strip, such as "Account sections"; this or `aria-labelledby` is required.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible heading that names the tab strip; use it instead of `aria-label` when such a heading exists.

props.name: value
props.description: Id of this panel; the `TabsTrigger` with the same `value` opens it.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel's content, shown while its tab is selected.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the panel (padding, a min-height so the layout does not jump between tabs).

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep inactive panels mounted (hidden) so form state is preserved.

props.name: size
props.description: Minimum height and padding: sm, md (default), lg, matching Input. Legacy names are deprecated aliases.

props.name: error
props.description: Error styling without a message. Prefer `errorMessage` so users learn what to fix.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Hint shown under the field (length, format). Linked via `aria-describedby`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Validation message shown under the field. Sets the error state and `aria-invalid`, and replaces `helperText` while present.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional visible label. When set, renders a `<label>` associated with the textarea via `htmlFor` / `id`.

props.name: label
props.description: Short verb shown as the button text ("Undo", "Retry", "View").

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs when the action is pressed; the toast dismisses itself afterwards.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable key for the toast (also used by dismissal callbacks).

props.name: message
props.description: Toast content. Keep it to one short line.

props.name: tone
props.description: Severity (default: "neutral"). "error" is announced assertively.

props.name: variant
props.description: Severity under its old name; `default` maps to `neutral`. When both are set, `tone` wins.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional inline action, such as Undo.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds before auto-dismiss; `Infinity` persists. Omit on controlled items to keep managing timing yourself.

props.name: toasts
props.description: Controlled mode: the toasts to render, oldest first (the newest renders closest to the screen edge). Omit to render the imperative `toast()` queue.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Controlled mode: called when a toast is clicked, its action runs, or its `duration` elapses. Ignored in imperative mode (the queue dismisses itself).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the plate is clicked (pointer shortcut; wire to dismiss).

props.name: tone
props.description: Severity (default: "neutral"): icon, colors, and `role` (error = alert).

props.name: variant
props.description: Severity under its old name; `default` maps to `neutral`. When both are set, `tone` wins.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional inline action button, such as Undo. Pressing it also dismisses.

props.name: duration
props.description: Auto-dismiss after this many ms, paused on hover and focus. `Infinity` persists and shows a dismiss button. Needs `onDismiss`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Removes the toast (timer, action, or the dismiss button call it).

props.name: children
props.description: Toast content. Keep it to one short line.

props.name: id
props.description: Reuse an id to replace a toast in place (e.g. "Saving..." then "Saved").

props.name: tone
props.description: Severity (default: "neutral"). The `toast.success()` style helpers set it for you.

props.name: variant
props.description: Severity under its old name; `default` maps to `neutral`. When both are set, `tone` wins.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional inline action, such as Undo.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds before auto-dismiss (default 5000); `Infinity` persists.

props.name: success
props.description: Queues a success toast (CheckCircle, green).

props.name: warning
props.description: Queues a warning toast (AlertTriangle, purple).

props.name: error
props.description: Queues an error toast (AlertCircle, red), announced with `role="alert"`.

props.name: info
props.description: Queues an info toast (Info, blue).

props.name: dismiss
props.description: Removes one toast by id, or every toast when called without one.

props.name: content
props.description: Short supplementary hint. Plain text; no links or buttons.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Pass one focusable element so keyboard users can open the tooltip and hear it.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the trigger (default "top"). It flips to the opposite side when this one would overflow the viewport.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the balloon sits along the trigger edge (default "center"). `start` and `end` line its leading or trailing edge up with the trigger's, for a trigger at the edge of a row; the caret still points at the trigger.

props.name: position
props.deprecated: Use `side`. Still honoured when `side` is not passed.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing on hover or focus (default 200). Hiding is immediate.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Max width of the balloon, any CSS length (default "200px"); text wraps inside it. This stays a free CSS length because no token describes a reading width: the spacing scale stops at 96px and the breakpoints are page widths. Widen it for a long hint rather than shortening the copy.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper (e.g. a width class for a full-width trigger).

props.name: id
props.description: Unique, stable id across the whole tree.

props.name: label
props.description: Row content.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain-text label for type-ahead when `label` is not a string.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional 1-bit icon before the label.

props.name: children
props.description: Child nodes. An empty array still renders a (childless) branch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skip this node for selection and activation (it stays focusable).

props.name: nodes
props.description: Root nodes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the tree, such as "Files"; this or `aria-labelledby` is required.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible heading naming the tree; use it instead of `aria-label` when such a heading exists.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of open branches (controlled).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of branches open on first render (uncontrolled).

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires with the next list of open branch ids.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected node id (controlled). `null` for no selection.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Node selected on first render (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires when the selection changes.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Fires when a node is activated with Enter or a click (open the file, go to the route).

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Type-ahead on printable keys (default true).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the tree root.

props.name: name
props.description: Which icon to draw: a (the Lucide component name, e.g. `"Check"`, `"ChevronRight"`). Names held in data need the type too: annotate the field as `TuiIconName` or the literal with `as const`. A name with no bitmap still renders "?" at runtime rather than throwing.

props.name: size
props.description: Box size as a Tailwind size number: "3" (12px), "4" (16px, default), "5" (20px), "6" (24px), "8" (32px).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes (color, margin, etc.)

props.name: title
props.description: Pane title shown in the title bar; also names the pane and its scroll region.

props.name: status
props.description: Short status text at the right of the title bar ("tail -f", "3 errors", "12:04").

props.name: actions
props.description: Title bar actions (icon Buttons, a Badge). Keep them small (`size="sm"`).

props.name: variant
props.description: `active` marks the focused pane (accent ring + marker); default is `default`.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading element used for the title (default "h2"). Match your page outline.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scrolling body (default true). Set false to let content size the pane.

props.name: children
props.description: Pane content.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer frame (set width / height here).

props.name: bodyClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the body (padding, max-height).

props.name: children
props.description: Content to sit inside the padding and on top of the background.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all four sides, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px. Omit it for a flush Box.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Left/right inset when it differs from the vertical one; replaces `padding` on that axis.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Top/bottom inset when it differs from the horizontal one; replaces `padding` on that axis.

props.name: background
props.description: Semantic surface to paint behind the content. `card` sits on top of `container`, `container` sits on `page`; `inverse` also flips the text color so content stays readable. Omit it to stay transparent.

props.name: border
props.description: `hairline` wraps the content in the plate ring (outer stroke layer plus a 1px-inset fill layer) because `clip-path` would slice a real CSS border. A ringed Box with no `background` falls back to the `card` surface, so the ring reads as a stroke and not as a solid plate.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render when the Box is a landmark or a list item rather than a generic grouping (`section`, `nav`, `li`, ...). Defaults to `div`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes (width, height, position), merged with `cn()` so they beat the generated ones.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to center; it keeps its own layout inside the column.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Width of the centered column: `xs` 320px, `sm` 384px, `md` 448px (default, about the width of a sign-in card), `lg` 512px, `xl` 576px, `2xl` 672px, `none` to center a block that sizes itself.

props.name: andText
props.description: Whether to center the text as well as the box. On for empty states and splash copy; off (default) when the column holds form fields or prose, where ragged-right text is easier to read.

props.name: fullHeight
props.description: Whether to also center vertically in the viewport, for a splash, sign-in or error screen that owns the whole page. Off (default) keeps the block at the top of the flow.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so a centered block can be a `section` or the page `main` instead of a `div`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes (padding, background), merged with `cn()` so they win.

props.name: children
props.description: Page content; centered inside the max width and inset by the gutters.

props.name: size
props.description: Where the content stops growing: `sm` 640px, `md` 768px, `lg` 1024px (default, the reading width for most pages), `xl` 1280px, `full` no limit. The values track the breakpoint scale, so a container never straddles one.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Whether to inset the content from the viewport edges (20px, 40px from `lg` up). Turn it off only when a child already owns the edge, such as a full-bleed image or a nested Container.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so the page wrapper can be the real landmark (`main`, `header`, `footer`, `nav`) instead of a `div`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes (vertical padding, background), merged with `cn()` so they win.

props.name: children
props.description: Cells to place in the tracks; each child fills one cell in source order.

props.name: columns
props.description: Track count. Pass a number for a fixed grid, or a map such as `{ base: 1, md: 2, lg: 3 }` to change the count at a breakpoint. A map without `base` starts at one column.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between all tracks, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px (default), `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px.

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Space between rows when it differs from `gap`, for example a tight grid with airy rows.

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Space between columns when it differs from `gap`.

props.name: align
props.description: How cells sit vertically in their row. `stretch` (default) gives every card in a row the height of the tallest one; `start` lets them keep their own height.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes (width, padding, explicit row definitions), merged with `cn()` so they win.

props.name: children
props.description: Items to place side by side; they keep their own width and wrap as a unit.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items, used for both the row gap and the wrap gap, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px (default), `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px.

props.name: align
props.description: How items line up across the row. `center` (default) suits controls of mixed height; `baseline` lines up the text in a label plus value meta row.

props.name: justify
props.description: How leftover horizontal space is distributed. `start` (default) keeps the cluster tight; `between` pushes the first and last item to the edges of a full-width row such as a toolbar.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Whether items flow onto a new line when the row runs out of width. Leave it on (default) so button rows and tag lists survive narrow viewports; turn it off only when overflow is handled another way.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes (width, padding, self-alignment), merged with `cn()` so they win.

props.name: children
props.description: Stack contents; laid out along `axis` with `gap` between them.

props.name: gap
props.description: Maps to the spacing scale (`gap-*` utilities): `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px (default), `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes (width, padding, alignment overrides).

props.name: axis
props.description: Default vertical stack; horizontal for toolbars / button groups.

props.name: children
props.description: Text or markup to announce. It stays in the accessibility tree, so keep it short and literal.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Whether the content shows itself once anything inside it takes focus. Turn it on for a skip link, which must be invisible until a keyboard user tabs to it; the revealed element is statically positioned, so give it its own placement classes through `className`.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, when the hidden text is a `label` for a control or a `li` inside a list rather than a generic `span`.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: With `as="label"`, the `id` of the control this labels. The JSDoc below has always promised it; the type did not accept it until stories were type-checked.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes (placement for the focusable variant), merged with `cn()` so they win.
